name: cited
title: Cited
instructions: Cited checks whether AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Mode) cite a website when buyers ask about what it sells, and what to change so they do. Start with account_status. free_audit needs no account. For a paid audit: agent_signup (or sign in), setup_business, draft_questions, quote_audit, then run_audit, get_audit, get_recommendations and generate_fixes. Purchases only return checkout links for the human to open.

tools.name: free_audit
tools.title: Free AI Visibility Audit
tools.description: Free check of how AI answers 5 buyer questions about a website: whether the site is cited, which sites are cited instead, a 0-100 score, an executive summary and whether AI bots can reach the site. No account needed. The first call starts it and returns report_token; call again with report_token until status is 'completed' (2-4 minutes; each call waits up to 20 seconds, so no need to pause between calls). The same domain within 24 hours returns the same audit.

report_token.description: From an earlier free_audit call, to check on it.

tools.name: agent_signup
tools.title: Create Account For Your Human
tools.description: Create a Cited account for your human without a login. Returns an API key (shown once), a claim link and a 6-digit code for the human. Unclaimed accounts can add 1 business and run 1 audit (paid with a one-audit checkout link) and are deleted after 7 days. Pass owner_email to email them the claim link. Pass free_audit_token (the report_token of a finished free_audit) to bring that business and report into the new account. Not needed when already signed in.

agent_name.description: Your name, shown to the human (e.g. 'Claude').

owner_email.description: Optional: the human's email for the claim link.

free_audit_token.description: Optional: the report_token of a finished free_audit, to keep that business and report in the new account.

tools.name: account_status
tools.title: Account Status
tools.description: Who is signed in, the credit balance, claim status, the businesses on the account, the price list and the next step. Works without signing in (prices and how to start). Call this first.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.title: Buy Credits
tools.description: Get a Stripe checkout link for a credit pack (pack_id) or for one audit (one_audit=true; works before the account is claimed), or redeem a voucher_code. Without arguments it lists the packs. A link only starts a purchase: the human pays in the browser, and nothing is bought until account_status shows the new balance. 1 credit = $1.

pack_id.description: A pack id from the price list (account_status).

one_audit.description: Checkout for a single audit instead of a pack.

voucher_code.description: Redeem a voucher for free credits.

save_card.description: Save the card for later packs (default true).

tools.name: setup_business
tools.title: Set Up Business
tools.description: Add a business from its website, or update one (pass business_id). Only website is needed to add one: the name comes from the domain and industry defaults to 'other' unless you pass better ones. Also adds, changes or removes buyer personas and offerings (what the business sells). Unclaimed accounts can add one business.

business_id.description: Update this business instead of adding one.

description.description: What the business does (10+ words, 50+ characters).

service_areas.description: Cities or regions, for local or regional businesses.

personas.description: Buyer personas to add ({name, description}), change ({id, ...}) or remove ({id, remove: true}).

id.description: Set to change or remove one.

offerings.description: Products or services to add ({name, description, category}), change ({id, ...}) or remove ({id, remove: true}).

id.description: Set to change or remove one.

tools.name: get_business
tools.title: Get Business
tools.description: Without business_id: list the account's businesses. With it: the profile, buyer personas, offerings, the question set (and its re-check schedule) and recent audits.

tools.name: get_agent_brief
tools.title: Agent Brief
tools.description: One-page summary of what to focus on for a business: top open recommendations, quick wins, failing site checks and recent citation movement. Use it for 'what should I do next?'.

tools.name: draft_questions
tools.title: Draft Audit Questions
tools.description: The business's question set: the buyer questions each audit asks AI. Returns the set when there is one. With none (or regenerate=true, or add=true to draft more) it starts drafting and returns job_id; call again with job_id to save and return the drafted set. Pass questions to replace the set with your own list. Review the questions with the user before run_audit. Up to 25 questions.

business_id.description: Optional when the account has one business.

questions.description: Replace the set with these questions.

regenerate.description: Draft a new set even though one exists.

add.description: Draft more questions and add them to the set.

job_id.description: From an earlier call, to collect drafted questions.

tools.name: quote_audit
tools.title: Quote Audit
tools.description: What an audit of the business's question set costs in credits, the balance, and the models that can answer. Free; nothing is charged.

business_id.description: Optional when the account has one business.

models.description: Optional models to compare, from available_models.

tools.name: run_audit
tools.title: Run Audit
tools.description: Run a paid audit of the business's question set: every question goes to each engine's flagship and fast model (or the models you pass), three times each, and recommendations follow automatically. Spends credits: without confirm=true it only returns the cost, so ask the user, then call again with confirm=true. Credits come back if the run fails. Returns audit_id; poll get_audit.

business_id.description: Optional when the account has one business.

models.description: Optional models to compare, as [route/]provider:model from quote_audit's available_models. Each extra model costs more.

deep_recommendations.description: Look harder at why other sites were cited.

confirm.description: True only after the user approved the cost.

tools.name: get_audit
tools.title: Get Audit
tools.description: With audit_id: its status while it runs, then the report: a 0-100 score per model (Cited, Visibility, Share of Voice), the overall score, the executive summary, the site check, each question's answers with the sites cited instead, the share link and whether recommendations are ready. Without audit_id: the account's audits (filter by business_id).

include_answers.description: Full AI answers instead of excerpts.

tools.name: compare_audits
tools.title: Compare Audits
tools.description: Wins and drops between an audit and an earlier one of the same business: citations gained or lost per question and model, and score changes. Without baseline_audit_id it compares with the previous audit.

tools.name: schedule_recheck
tools.title: Schedule Re-check
tools.description: Re-run the business's question set on a schedule (every 7-90 days, default 30) and alert on citations gained or lost and score moves of 10+ points: in-app, by email, and to an optional webhook so an agent can react. Each re-check costs credits when it runs. off=true stops it.

business_id.description: Optional when the account has one business.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL for alerts; empty string removes it.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.title: Get Recommendations
tools.description: What to change on the site to get cited, from an audit: one item per buyer question the site loses and per site change, each with item_key, status (open, done, dismissed), the evidence behind it and its fix if one was made. Open items only unless include_closed. Also the price of fixes (the first ones are included with each audit).

audit_id.description: The audit (default: the newest finished one).

business_id.description: Use this business's newest finished audit.

include_closed.description: Also list done and dismissed items.

tools.name: update_recommendation
tools.title: Update Recommendation
tools.description: Mark a recommendation done or dismissed, or open it again. The status is kept for the business, so later audits show the item the same way.

audit_id.description: The audit (default: the newest finished one).

business_id.description: Use this business's newest finished audit.

tools.name: generate_fixes
tools.title: Generate Fixes
tools.description: Write the fix for recommendations: the files (schema markup, FAQ, page copy, llms.txt) and steps to put them on the site. Pass item_keys (up to 10) or all=true for every open item without a fix. Each audit includes the first fixes; beyond those each costs credits, and the call returns the price for the user to confirm (confirm=true) before spending.

audit_id.description: The audit (default: the newest finished one).

business_id.description: Use this business's newest finished audit.

confirm.description: The user agreed to the credits quoted.

tools.name: get_fixes
tools.title: Get Fixes
tools.description: With fix_id: the fix's files (with their content), where each goes, the steps and the last verification. Without: list fixes with their state (generating, ready, done, verified, working), optionally for one audit, recommendations run or business.

audit_id.description: The audit (default: the newest finished one).

business_id.description: Use this business's newest finished audit.

tools.name: update_fix
tools.title: Update Fix
tools.description: action 'done': the user put the fix on their site. 'undo': back to ready. 'verify': re-check the live site for the fix now (free); it moves to verified when every check passes, and the report says what is missing when one fails.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search Cited Docs
tools.description: Search the Cited help docs (how audits, scores, credits, fixes and the tools work) with query, or read one doc in full with path ('<category>/<slug>' from a result). No account needed.
